expected_record_metadata.title: Expression-level concordance and implementation sensitivity of ligand–receptor priority rankings in mouse cerebral ischemia
expected_record_metadata.description: Code, complete results, cell summaries, figure source data and observed environment locks for a cross-cohort reproducibility study in mouse cerebral ischemia. The analysis attributes the known shared-score ranking correction to scverse/liana PR #261, merge d4211373692e7b9c10210488ccb1efe06452b097. Full native LIANA 1.10.0 inference and fixed-commit aggregation-only replay are distinct execution scopes. A separate controlled-resource analysis executes native CellChat 2.2.0.9001 on all eleven original libraries, preserving full networks, native RDS scores, normalized sparse inputs, exact resource mappings and zero-effect diagnostics. The original v2 numerical analysis remains unchanged. Original project code is MIT licensed, derived tables/figures/manuscripts are CC BY 4.0, and third-party source/database files retain their own licenses. Large original GEO and corrected full-gene cell matrices are obtained separately; their aggregates and complete results are included.

metadata_precedence: .zenodo.json is used; CITATION.cff is ignored by Zenodo when both are present.

expected_file_scope.automatic_github_import: One source zipball at tag v3.0.0; verify actual record files and ZIP content rather than inferring from a DOI alone.
inside_repository_snapshot: complete test and descriptive result tables
native CellChat cache and lossless exports
not_in_repository_zip: the two separately attached GitHub release files
expected_file_scope.source_scope_limit: Inspected current upstream Zenodo/Invenio code supports one zipball upload; this is not proof of the precise deployed server version. The published record file listing is decisive.

required_public_record_checks: Record ID and production zenodo.org landing page resolve anonymously; record is published, not a reserved/draft identifier.
Use the record version-specific DOI in manuscript Code availability; preserve the concept DOI separately for all versions. Never derive one by arithmetic on the other.
Title, one creator Zhu, Sihuan, ORCID 0009-0005-9705-0585, affiliation, version 3.0.0, software resource type, open access and declared license agree with fixed .zenodo.json.
Description preserves known upstream fix attribution and distinct complete/native versus aggregation-only execution scopes; mixed third-party and derived-output licenses remain explicit.
Related GitHub release identifier points to v3.0.0; actual tag resolves to analysis commit 00067 rather than later editorial HEAD.
Enumerate each actual record file with name/size/checksum/download URL; download and check advertised checksum plus local SHA256.
Open the source ZIP, identify root prefix, verify CRC, FILE_INDEX scope and all member SHA256; confirm full numerical/figure-source/environment coverage against fixed release.
Do not describe external GitHub release attachments or excluded original matrices as archived by this DOI unless the actual record files show them.
Record version-specific and concept DOI separately; publication date is real public-release time and confers no retrospective upstream priority.
